title: Guided Meditation (Meeting a Friend)
fullTitle: Soul Snack # 37: Guided Meditation (Meeting a Friend)
description: In this Soul Snack, Gary invites listeners to experience a guided meditation designed to foster inner connection, self-awareness, and peace. Rather than a discussion, this Soul Snack offers a direct experience – an opportunity to step away from external noise and journey inward toward clarity and presence.

Set on an imagined beach, this meditation leads listeners to a serene encounter with a “friend” – a wise, intuitive presence that offers personal guidance and reassurance. Gary emphasizes the importance of safety and presence during the meditation, encouraging listeners to pause real-world activity and engage fully with the inner journey.
This short, nourishing experience reminds us that we can always return to ourselves, ask meaningful questions, and receive profound insights.
The answers you seek may already be within you – this meditation simply helps you listen.
Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

(00:30) – A warm welcome and invitation to experience a guided inner journey (01:00) – Why you shouldn’t listen while driving or in an unsafe space (02:10) – Visualization begins: walking along a peaceful beach (03:15) – Encountering your “friend” and asking the most important question in your life (05:20) – Returning from the meditation with new insight and calm

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Find a quiet, safe space and take a few moments to be still. What question is most pressing in your life right now? Can you quiet your thoughts and listen for an answer from within? Trust that you have access to wisdom when you pause, breathe, and connect. Use this meditation whenever you need grounding, reassurance, or a sense of companionship.
